description: Area stradale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cecina.ldpgis.it. Dataset containing the area within the road boundaries. It is the plane formed by the roadway and the relevant bands, i.e. quays, sidewalks and tracks; it can include different types of roads, both pedestrian and road or other, such as the tramway. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road area" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include progetto-opendata-highvalue. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
